purposeStatement: A horizontal trail of links showing the user's position in a content hierarchy, last crumb being the current page. Use for path/hierarchy navigation only — NOT a tab bar, primary nav menu, or stepper.

antiPatterns.pattern: <div>/<nav> of <a> tags with raw '>' or '/' text and inline color/gap literals
antiPatterns.reason: re-invents the breadcrumb with ad-hoc spacing, colors, and a one-off separator instead of registered tokens and primitives
